IRS high-low per diem for 2026-11-15 (Notice 2026-60, Oct. 1, 2026 - Sept. 30, 2027): high $329 ($86 meals), low $230 ($74 meals). Transportation industry M&IE $80 CONUS / $86 OCONUS; incidentals only $5. Chicago, Illinois is high-cost October 1 – November 30 and April 1 – September 30. On 2026-11-15 the high rate of $329 applies.

Rates from IRS and GSA publications. General information, not tax advice.
